issues.finding: Player locomotion currently uses phase-preserved 12Hz cycles, not traveled-distance gait. The plan assumption is inaccurate. Fleet Foot motion coherence still needs review; no gait/balance change is silently introduced.

issues.finding: Acceptance is a generic counter, with a gameplay recovery consumer. Bridge explicitly once; never emit another recovery.

issues.finding: No authored multi-frame survivor activation; survivorAction is one existing action frame. Do not relabel hurt/death as upgrade animation.

issues.finding: Server admits 35 families / 6 fusions / 5 weapons / 3 survivors. Catalogue preview availability is broader than combat admission.

issues.finding: Co-op choice resolves straight to active in index.ts; a local-only hold would diverge simulation and recovery.
